title: KITCOEK Key Facts — Director, Placements, Fees, Admissions, Overview
text:
KITCOEK KEY FACTS

DIRECTOR
The Director of KIT's College of Engineering Kolhapur (KITCOEK) is Prof. (Dr.) Mohan B. Vanarotti. Contact: 9902544599. Email: vanarotti.mohan@kitcoek.in
Dean of Admissions: Dr. Mahesh B. Shinde. Mobile: 7030861199. Email: admissions@kitcoek.in
Associate Dean Admissions: Mr. Amar H. Tikole. Mobile: 9272319199.

COLLEGE OVERVIEW
KIT's College of Engineering Kolhapur (KITCOEK) was established in May 1983. It is the first self-financed engineering college in Maharashtra.
Location: R.S. No. 199B/1-3, Gokul-Shirgoan, Kolhapur - 416 234, Maharashtra, India.
Phone: 077690011999. Email: info@kitcoek.in. Website: https://www.kitcoek.in
Campus: 11-hectare campus. Over 4500 students enrolled.
Faculty: 235+ highly qualified teaching professionals, 200+ with PhDs.
Programs: 10 undergraduate programs, 6 postgraduate (M.Tech) programs, 4 PhD research centres.
Alumni: 19,000+ engineers graduated.
Accreditation: NAAC A+ Grade with CGPA 3.33 awarded by NAAC Bengaluru in 2023.
NBA Accreditation: 6 departments NBA accredited — Civil Engineering, CSE, Environmental Engineering, Electronics & Telecom Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biotechnology.
Affiliation: Permanent Affiliation from Shivaji University Kolhapur. Empowered Autonomous status.
Rankings: Participates in NIRF rankings. NIRF 2025 reports available on website.

DEPARTMENTS OFFERED
KITCOEK offers the following 10 undergraduate programs and departments:
1. Biotechnology Engineering (B.Tech + M.Tech Biochemical Engineering)
2. Civil Engineering (B.Tech + M.Tech)
3. Civil and Environmental Engineering (B.Tech)
4. Computer Science and Engineering - CSE (B.Tech + M.Tech)
5. Computer Science and Business Systems - CSBS (B.Tech)
6. Computer Science Engineering - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - CSE AIML (B.Tech)
7. Electrical Engineering (B.Tech)
8. Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - E&TC (B.Tech + M.Tech)
9. Mechanical Engineering (B.Tech + M.Tech Mechanical Engineering Design)
10. Basic Sciences and Humanities (supporting department)

PLACEMENT RECORDS
KITCOEK has an excellent placement record:
- Total students placed in recent placement season: 652 students.
- Highest package: Rs. 27.5 LPA (Lakhs Per Annum).
- Number of companies that visited campus for recruitment: 157 companies.
- Average package: Rs. 4.5 to 6 LPA (approximate).
Top recruiters: KPIT, Wipro, Wipro PARI Private Limited, Adani Electricity Mumbai, Adani Group, TCS, Tata Consultancy Services, Infosys, Cognizant, L&T (Larsen & Toubro), Persistent Systems, Mahindra, Bosch, Cummins, Forbes Marshall, Kirloskar, Bajaj Auto, and many more.
The Training and Placement (T&P) Cell / TNP Cell ensures every student gets quality placement through campus drives, pre-placement training, mock interviews, and internship facilitation.
Contact TNP Cell: tnp@kitcoek.in

ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS — UNDERGRADUATE B.TECH
Eligibility for B.Tech First Year (FY B.Tech):
- Passed HSC (12th standard) or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
- Minimum 45% aggregate marks in PCM (40% for reserved categories).
- Valid MHT-CET score OR JEE Main score required.
- Admission through DTE Maharashtra CAP (Centralized Admission Process) rounds.
- Management Quota seats available for eligible candidates.
Key documents required: 10th marksheet, 12th marksheet, MHT-CET/JEE scorecard, caste certificate (if applicable), domicile certificate, Aadhar card, passport photos.
Admission Helpline: 7030861199 (Dean Admissions — Dr. Mahesh B. Shinde)

ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS — POSTGRADUATE M.TECH
Eligibility for M.Tech:
- B.Tech/B.E. degree in relevant engineering branch with minimum 50% aggregate.
- Valid GATE score preferred (mandatory for AICTE scholarship).
- Admission through DTE Maharashtra CAP or direct institute-level admission.

ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS — Ph.D PROGRAM
Eligibility for Ph.D:
- M.Tech/M.E. or equivalent with minimum 55% marks.
- Valid GATE/NET score or institutional entrance test.
- Research centres available in: Civil, Mechanical, CSE, and other departments.

FEE STRUCTURE
Fee Proposal for AY 2026-27 and AY 2025-26 are published on the official website under Mandatory Disclosure.
FRA (Fee Regulation Authority) approved Fee Structure AY 2026-27 is available at: https://www.kitcoek.in/manditory-disclosure
Hostel Fee Structure AY 2025-26 is also available on the website.
For exact fee figures contact: Dean Admissions at 7030861199 or email admissions@kitcoek.in
Note: Fee figures change yearly. Always confirm with the college for the current academic year.

SCHOLARSHIPS
Government scholarships available based on category and income:
- SC/ST students: Full Tuition Fee + Development Fee + Exam Fee + Maintenance Allowance.
- OBC/SBC/VJNT (income below 1.5 lakh): Half Tuition Fee + Exam Fee + Maintenance Allowance.
- EWS Open category (income below 8 lakh, Non Creamy Layer): Full Tuition Fee.
- Minority scholarships: Central Govt Rs.25,000 and State Govt Rs.50,000 (Jain, Christian, Muslim, Sikh, Parsi communities).
- Handicap/Divyang: No income limit, Full Tuition Fee + Development Fee.
- Central Sector Scholarship: Income below 6 lakh — FE to TE Rs.10,000/year, BE Rs.20,000/year.
- J&K students: As per Government policy.
- TFWS (Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme): Available for eligible students.
- KIT Merit Scholarship: Based on academic performance.
